q2_gaps: a relational of-phrase whose possessor is itself a PLURAL ('the members of the student associationS') — the Possessive/genitive NP rules attach one possessed symbol to one possessor, and there is no nominal-side dependent-witness machinery (Skolem functions exist only inside rules), so the per-association membership collapses to a single members-group PartOf a single associations-group
notes: Definite plurals correctly take group witnesses rather than Inheritance; the passive by-phrase takes Agent, 'elect' takes Theme (choose-class, object unchanged), the present-tense habitual correctly carries no status atom, and the distributive predicate gets both the group event and the per-member rule at 1.0/0.9. 'on campus' correctly keeps the surface preposition entity-attached rather than folding into LocatedIn, with the article-less NP staying a constant.
